Sundogs | Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer | Remote EST / CET | Part-Time

We're Sundogs, an early-stage startup (15 people) founded by ex-Googlers, we use AI and human creative expertise to transform video advertising.

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst (Python/SQL) on a part-time / freelance basis to help deliver and productize some strategic analyses we provide to our clients. The analyses tap into a large & rich dataset of 500+ video creative components, to help brand refine their creative approach in video advertising.

The job is full remote, we look for candidates between the CET and EST timezones, in Europe or US/Canada (Western Europe / Eastern US).

Full JD: https://tinyurl.com/4ekfzfzj Find out more: https://sundogs.io/

To apply, please send your resume and an intro at work@sundogs.io.
